answer: With a Weekly community check-in streak over thirty days verified by on-chain log entries, trust accrues only through repeated presence: every week the applicant signs in, the on-chain log entries go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so a fake identity that lapses even once loses its standing and must start over. The design treats each week as a ledge: small alone, decisive in sequence. When the gale settles over the pigment, the streak holds because every week carried its own proof.
